_doc: A ship struck down on the town map breaks into salvage (world/innerMap/harbour.js scatterWreck): `pieces` [min, max] by hull, floating on the water where she lay and up to `spread` tiles round (each a ground item you swim or wade to and pick up). `loot` picks a piece's goods by weight (kind = how it floats: planks, rope, sail, crate, chest; drawn from the LPC lumber, crate and chest sheets). A crate carries goods from her hold when she had any, else one of crateGoods; a strongbox (chest) holds gold, only on the hulls listed in its `hulls`.
